errors.ORDER_HAS_NO_EMAIL: The order has no e-mail address.
errors.INVALID_EMAIL: This is not a valid e-mail address.
errors.EMAIL_UNCHANGED: This is already the e-mail address of the order.
errors.CUSTOMER_ANONYMIZED: This address belongs to an erased customer.
errors.CUSTOMER_LIMIT: The ticket limit per customer of this address would be exceeded. Tick the box to override it.
errors.ORDER_CHANGED: The order was changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_RETRYABLE: Only failed e-mails can be sent again.
errors.EMAIL_RECIPIENT_OUTDATED: This e-mail went to an address the order no longer has. Resend it from the order instead – it then goes to the current address.
errors.ORDER_ANONYMIZED: The contact data of this order have been erased. The e-mail address cannot be changed.
errors.NO_RECIPIENTS: No buyer matches the selected recipients.
errors.CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Please confirm that you understand the consequences.
errors.EVENT_ARCHIVED: An archived event cannot be cancelled.
errors.EVENT_NOT_LIVE: Only published or postponed events can be postponed.
errors.TEST_ORDERS_PRESENT: The event still has test orders.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.

feedback.emailChanged: E-mail address changed. The buyer got the new order link.
feedback.cancellationStarted: Event cancelled. The orders are being cancelled and refunded in the background.
feedback.cancellationAlreadyRunning: A cancellation run is already working on this event.
feedback.postponed: Event postponed. {recipients, plural, =0 {No buyers were notified.} one {# buyer is being notified.} other {# buyers are being notified.}}
feedback.mailingQueued: {recipients, plural, one {Message queued for # buyer.} other {Message queued for # buyers.}}

orderMessage.title: Message to the buyer
orderMessage.description: Sends a free-text e-mail with the shop branding to the buyer. It is logged in the order history.
orderMessage.noEmail: The order has no e-mail address.
orderMessage.subject: Subject

emailChange.title: Change buyer e-mail
emailChange.description: Only the e-mail address changes; name and address stay as invoiced.
emailChange.overrideLimits: Ignore the ticket limit per customer
emailChange.confirmText: The order moves to {email}. All earlier order links stop working, the new address gets a fresh link, and the old address is notified.

orderEmails.title: E-mails
orderEmails.description: All e-mails sent for this order.

cancellation.title: Cancel event
cancellation.description: Cancels all orders of this event, refunds paid tickets and informs every buyer.
cancellation.descriptionCancelled: Shows the cancellation runs. Run the assistant again to pick up orders that are left.
cancellation.wizardDescription: The event is marked as cancelled and its orders are processed in the background. This cannot be undone.
cancellation.notify: Send an e-mail to every affected buyer
cancellation.understood: I understand that orders are cancelled and money is refunded.
cancellation.running: A cancellation run is working on this event.
cancellation.manualNotice: {count, plural, one {# unpaid order needs} other {# unpaid orders need}} a manual decision (it contains tickets of other events or is partly paid). It stays untouched.

preview.unpaid: Unpaid: {orders} orders ({tickets} tickets) are cancelled, seats are released.
preview.paid: Paid: {orders} orders ({tickets} tickets, {amount}) are cancelled and refunded.
preview.multi: {orders} of them also contain tickets of other events; those stay valid.

postpone.title: Postpone event
postpone.description: Tickets stay valid. Optionally tell all buyers the new date.
postpone.newDateHint: Optional. Change the real date in the event details.
postpone.notify: Send an e-mail to all buyers

mailing.title: Message to buyers
mailing.description: Sends an e-mail to the buyers of this event. Every address receives it once.
mailing.subject: Subject
mailing.bodyHint: Plain text; empty lines start a new paragraph.
mailing.previewHint: The text is placed in the shop e-mail layout.
mailing.confirmText: The message goes to {count, plural, one {# recipient} other {# recipients}}.
